capabilities: Capture memos in a persistent composer
Attach OS and vault files via drag & drop or clipboard paste
Filter memos by include/exclude tags and a calendar date picker
Toggle interactive checkboxes that update the underlying file
Search memo bodies and tag names in real time
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin store; install manually from GitHub releases or via BRAT. The author requests donations.
motivation: The author was inspired by the clean interface of usememos.com and wanted that memo style inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated distraction-free view for jotting short memos with attachments and filtering the feed by tag, date, and text.

relations.evidence: inspired by the clean interface of usememos.com

summary: Quick-capture memo interface with a persistent composer that saves each memo as a Markdown file with attachments, tags, and interactive todos.
